create_distribution_binomial: create a Binomial distribution with total_count and probs or logits parameters
sample_from_binomial: sample random values from a Binomial distribution with a given sample_shape
compute_log_prob_binomial: compute the log probability of a value under a Binomial distribution
compute_entropy_binomial: compute the entropy of a Binomial distribution with uniform total_count
enumerate_binomial_support: enumerate all integer support values from 0 to total_count for a Binomial distribution
